statistics: Median paired sequence speedups; each duration is median of three repeated sums. Exploratory 6000 map-cluster bootstrap resamples on four fixed maps, not independent queries. No intervals for four validation cases or diagnostic family.

environment.protocol: Sequential complete episodes; three randomized repeats; paths and edit processing included; validation outside timers; shared immutable model preparation reported separately.
environment.query_budget: 3,000,000 expansions per D* Lite query; adaptive backend call retains its 3,000,000 guard. No successful final run is capped.

prior_phases.reason: D* Lite originally used one cumulative 3M guard for a 13-query episode. Only whole paired episodes that never hit that guard are retained; all partial episodes are repeated under the per-query guard.
prior_phases.runner_change: Only the max_expansions assignment before each query, outside its timer. Verified exact source-text diff and identical algorithm sources.
